_readme: THE ACCEPT RULES — how each check’s own allowlist takes an accepted key (PLAN.md C1). ONE source for both callers: `pnpm findings accept` (scripts/findings/registry.mjs → accept-rules.mjs) and the server’s one-click Mark OK (aidream aidream/services/platform_checks/accept_rules.py fetches THIS file from main). A rule is data; its `kind` is implemented twice (JS here, Python there) and proven byte-identical by accept-corpus.json, which the server re-checks before every commit. A check with `no_accept` cannot be accepted, in the registry’s own words. Change a kind → run `node scripts/findings/accept-rules.mjs --write-corpus` and commit both files.

url-state-written-outside-the-canonical-.no_accept: scripts/check-url-state.ts has no allowlist (its exemptions are code rules). Accepting needs an allowlist there first, then an adapter in scripts/findings/registry.mjs.

complete-list-reads-postgrest-silently-c.no_accept: scripts/check-unbounded-reads.ts has no allowlist or baseline (it is an advisory census). Accepting needs one there first, then an adapter in scripts/findings/registry.mjs.

accept.reasons_readme: Why each entry of scripts/api-contracts-baseline.json was accepted (written by `pnpm findings accept`). scripts/api-contracts-baseline.json is a plain array the check reads as-is, so the reasons live here.

cx-source-attribution-is-registered.no_accept: The registry is a vocabulary, not an allowlist of defects: the fix IS registering the value. There is nothing to accept.

access-errors-surfaces-that-guess-why-a-.no_accept: This check is accepted by an inline `// access-errors: ok — <reason>` marker on the flagged line or the line above it (a source edit you make by hand), never a key list. An adapter would go in scripts/findings/registry.mjs.

no-dead-ends-door-law.no_accept: The allowlist is a TypeScript module (scripts/dead-ends/allowlist.ts, DEAD_END_ALLOWLIST: { file, rule?, reason }) — a hand edit with a reason. An adapter would append to that array.

type-escape-hatch-ratchet.no_accept: A per-category COUNT ratchet (scripts/type-escape-baseline.json) that only shrinks: there is no per-site entry to accept.

ui-primitives-check.no_accept: Exemptions are code sets inside scripts/check-ui-primitives.ts, not a key list: every item is new.

settings-new-knob-shaped-constants-ratch.no_accept: scripts/settings-hardcoded-allowlist.json ONLY SHRINKS by its own law (`_how`): a new entry is a human's hand edit with a reason, never a command.

package-logic-re-grown-outside-its-packa.no_accept: Keys name the register row and list that covers the file (census / shapeCensus / inputCensus in scripts/check-package-twins.mjs); census entries are hand edits to that register.

scroll-chain-clipped-tables-lists.no_accept: scripts/check-scroll-chain.ts has no allowlist or baseline: every item is new.

canonical-agent-model-pickers.no_accept: Only an inline exemption in the source file (scripts/check-canonical-pickers.ts documents it) — no key list.

surfaces-running-an-agent-without-naming.no_accept: scripts/check-agent-disclosure.ts has no allowlist or baseline: every item is new.

route-metadata-and-favicons.no_accept: scripts/check-route-metadata.ts has no allowlist or baseline: every item is new.
